name: busybox-lineedit
description: busybox libbb command-line editor (src/libbb/lineedit.c) packaged as a reusable library slice so non-shell binaries can get the SAME arrow-key history/editing hush uses (todos gcode band): deps on libbb-core, adds the editor + its read_key/signal/poll support. lib.json <- bin.json deps convention (os/curl precedent).
